title: Prohibit Ambient Rng In Authored Generation
forbids: authored generation source calling ambient engine RNG, Math.random, undeclared official generators, or internal mapgen-core RNG
why: Swooper authored generation owns deterministic RNG policy. Runtime steps may invoke only the engine capabilities selected by their step contract and exposed through the narrowed deps.engine surface.
message: Keep authored generation off engine RNG and official generators.
